title: The Sea Chord
meta_description: The Sea Chord is a bright 1-bedroom condo just 3 minutes from the beach, featuring a private balcony, community pool, and all the comforts for a perfect coastal getaway.
description_expanded:
Welcome to The Sea Chord, your perfect beachside retreat along the stunning 30A coastline. This charming one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo is designed for comfort and convenience, offering everything you need for a relaxing escape. Whether you're a family or a group of friends, this home is an ideal getaway just steps from the sugar-white sands of Walton Dunes Beach Access---a quick 3-minute walk down the street.

Inside, the condo greets you with natural light streaming into the living room, where cozy seating beckons for movie nights or an afternoon nap. A Murphy bed easily folds down to offer extra sleeping space, seamlessly transforming the space into a comfortable retreat for an additional guest.

The fully equipped kitchen invites you to whip up beachside breakfasts, complete with barstool seating for casual dining. The kitchen comes stocked with a crockpot, griddle, and plates, bowls, and cups for children. You'll also find a community grill nearby waiting to be fired up.

When it's time to relax, step out to the private balcony where you can enjoy both Gulf and lake views while letting the fresh ocean breeze rejuvenate your senses.. There's even a guitar ready to grab off the wall and strum along to the sounds of the waves.

The loft bedroom has two queen beds, providing ample room for restful sleep after a day of sun and surf. A full bathroom with a convenient shower makes washing off the salt and sand easy. Plus, in-home laundry and convenient parking make your stay as hassle-free as possible. Additional amenities include card and board games, beach toys, children's toys, and beach chairs.

When you're not lounging at the beach, take advantage of the large, community pool and hot tub, surrounded by sun loungers perfect for soaking up the Florida sunshine. Whether you're here for a quick getaway or an extended stay, The Sea Chord delivers the perfect combination of beach access, comfort, and style---a true coastal haven for families and groups alike.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Please note the elevator at this property is managed by the HOA, not AvantStay.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- There are two parking spaces available for your use. Each booking will receive 2 parking passes, and these must be displayed at all times.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
